meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理单细胞分析的注释数据矩阵
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常处理单细胞RNA-seq数据或.h5ad文件。
copy.tagline_en: Manage annotated matrices for single-cell analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with single-cell RNA-seq data or .h5ad files.

howto.what: 让 Claude 使用 anndata 库创建、读取、写入带注记的数据矩阵，处理 .h5ad/.zarr 等文件，并进行子集、过滤、拼接、稀疏矩阵转换等操作；支持 backed 模式处理大文件。分析工作流仍由 scanpy 等工具负责。
howto.when: 当用户要求读取或保存 .h5ad/.zarr 文件、操作 AnnData 对象，或与 scanpy 等 scverse 生态系统工具集成时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 anndata 读取 data.h5ad，并列出观测和基因的元数据。
say.note: 会读取文件并展示 obs、var 等信息。

say.text: 用 backed 模式打开这个大文件，筛选质量评分高于 0.8 的细胞。
say.note: 只加载筛选后的子集到内存。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to use the anndata library to create, read, and write annotated data matrices, handle .h5ad/.zarr files, and perform subsetting, filtering, concatenation, and sparse-matrix conversion. Backed mode is supported for large files; analysis workflows remain with scanpy and other tools.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to read or save .h5ad/.zarr files, manipulate AnnData objects, or integrate with scverse ecosystem tools such as scanpy.

say_en.text: Use anndata to read data.h5ad and list the metadata for observations and genes.
say_en.note: Reads the file and shows obs, var.

say_en.text: Concatenate batch1.h5ad and batch2.h5ad into one object with a batch label.
say_en.note: Merges via ad.concat and marks source.

say_en.text: Open this large file in backed mode and filter cells with quality score above 0.8.
say_en.note: Only loads the filtered subset into memory.
